notes.title: The bug truth has finally come out of the skill store 🐍!
notes.content:
The Skill Store 🐍 is out! But because there were too many bugs, I held back some of them.
At present, the characters who can use the skill shop are: Ghost Qiang, Zhuge Li, Monkey Jiaojun, Xuan Cheems, Gua Tan Old Monkey, Yin Surprise Monkey, Zhan Tang Monkey Jing, Thief Greira, Dorga Brigade Commander, Chestnut Fly Brother, and Li Situ
Fixed a bug where the Void Kun God would not use buff skills.
The Void Kun God skill "Are you really crazy because of you" counterattacks for 3 rounds → 2 rounds.
When the number of days reaches 0, other maps except Kuncheng will be blocked normally (unlocked after clearing the 3rd floor of Kuncheng).
King of Haste has been added to equip Glove equipment. Billy can't equip spears anymore.
Fixed choosing not to drink ice in the Blue Lobster Cave! Cool water, ice! The bug that the cold water will disappear directly.
The duration of the Critical Strike Chance added by the Monkey "Early Coffin" has been changed to 2 turns.
Tearing up the Green Corpse Letter in the Joker Country will no longer attract enemies.
Reduced the overall number of battles in the Joker Nation.
Increased the difficulty of Clown's Kingdom boss fights at level 2 and 3
Fixed Meet Ice! The original little monkey, but the bug that joined the team was the little monkey in the underworld.
Enhanced the "Melon Grain Deployment" skill of the old monkey.

notes.title: 🤔
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where Eluddick could attach a random unit with a wet status while not in the party.
Added Action Ailment Resistance to late-stage quest monsters, +10% for level 2, +20% for level 3, and +25% for level 4.
Increased Chestnut Fly's base health. The passive skill "Two Days of Might" adds +20% critical strike chance, and HP is automatically restored. The skill "Bear with it, eat, you" has a 66% → 70% chance of adding Wet.
Said Dory's skill "Grenade" has a new 12% chance to add a scorching status, MP cost 12→15, "Said offensive reason" no longer consumes MP but consumes 10TP.
Clown Monkey Skill "So you're also a Joker?" The effect lasts 1→2 rounds, the MP cost is 0→10, and the cooldown is 0→2. "Everyone here is a clown" has been changed to add chaos to all enemies and random units of your team with a 50% chance. The passive skill "Sand Mouth" has been changed to: -3% accuracy rate, and a 3% chance to gain the number of actions +1 status when attacked.
Monkey Shhatcheson can now equip spellbook weapons.
The agility of the Kuncheng monster has been greatly increased.
Fixed a bug where the "Claw Strike" of the Kun Demon and the Chicken Banshee did not have a skill animation.
Plastic chair "plastic non-degradable" +100% chance of being attacked→ +40% chance of being attacked.

notes.title: 🗿Weakens Eluddick and🤓☝🏼 enhances Monkey Awakening
notes.content:
Neruddick's skills "Ass Ice Cream Your Name" and "Atlantis, Under the Sea" have been nerfed by magic attack bonuses, and MP cost has been increased.
Enhanced Liu Xing's skill "Regurgitation Storm" for 3 rounds → 4 turns. Added a new passive "Dual Wield" for Liu Xing, but only equips pistol and wand weapons.
Changed the passive skill "Dual Wielding": The off-hand can also equip weapons, but the overall ATK & Magic ATK *90% and cannot equip a shield.
Changed the passive skill "Bull's Eye": +2% accuracy, restore 5% MP, 5% HP, and 5TP upon kill.
Weakened Tang Mage Set: Magic Attack x120%→112%
Strengthened the skill "Clear Magazine" for 5 times 30% attack → 5 times 33% attack

notes.title: Atlantis, under the sea, under the sea.
notes.content:
The new character Eluddick has been deployed!
Added instructions for characters when unlocking them.
Added +50% frostbite chance to Wet status.
Fixed a bug where the enchantment of "I'm waiting for you in Sand City at 8 o'clock tonight" could not be dismantled properly.
Added a battle background image for Sand City.
The Desert Sandworm's "Devour" skill is no longer a group damage
Now equipped with the Prison Flying Wheelchair can now enter airplane mode normally!
Airplane Mode Evasion Rate reduced to 15%, +15% Magic Evasion added.
Stun Status added -25% Evasion Chance & Magic Evasion.
Reduced the stats of the Lightning Yellow Shrimp and removed the chance to stun the "Thunder Pincers".
Adjusted the size of the image displayed by Gargoyle's skill "🗿".
Liu Xing can now be equipped with pistol and spear-type weapons.
Nerfed Billy's "Stand Up" and "Fried Rice" damage bonuses. "Oh Sell Shaw's" adds 1 round cooldown, costing 8→10 mps
Increased the base movement speed of the Clown Monkey.
Changed the sound effects of Happy Chestnut Cat's skills. Changed the skill sound for "Executive Leave".
You can use the item normally Freshly fried ice! Finish.
International Mouth Day can distribute items normally Throat lozenges!

notes.title: 🤓☝🏼 The difficulty of monsters in the late stage has been doubled
notes.content:
New town Desert Oasis. (Only mercenaries can be hired at the moment).
🤓☝🏼 Doubled the attack power and magic attack of late-game monsters. And increased critical strike chance.
Added a new item in the item shop in the kingdom of Qi, Fu Hongcha.
Fixed a bug where old archives Petrode Parker and Bateman did not have walking diagrams.
Fixed a bug where Baxman didn't have a stunt.
Nerfed the Clown Hat.
Changed the eight-point sand city to level 4 difficulty, and the reward to random level 2, level 3 equipment.

notes.title: Pache ♂Go!
notes.content:
The fourth tank character, Billy Monkeyrington, has been implemented!
🤓☝🏼 Significantly increased the difficulty of Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 dungeons
🤓☝🏼 In the queue! When the lobby selects a role, a description of the role positioning is added for each character.
The Clown Hat given when unlocking the Clown Monkey is now wearable by all characters.
Fixed a bug where the reward for clearing Kuncheng was that the brother's egg was armor and had 0 stats (normally, it was a staff and could summon friendly Kunren)
Added a two-piece set effect [Chicken, You're Too Beautiful] to the middle split head and brother's eggs.
🤓☝🏼 Fixed a bug where Clown Monkey's "It's pitiful" could not be burned when it was not attached
Clown Monkey "Everyone here is a Clown" has a 999% chance to add chaos → 100% chance to add chaos
Adjusted the attributes of all monsters in the Unstoppable Swamp.
Weakened cosmetic timer +4 agility → +3 agility
Skill: "Suppression" cooldown for 2 turns → 1 turn. "Protection" restores 10% HP. "Stone-throwing marker" 80% magic attack→ 90% magic attack. "King Kong Nyorai" lasts 3 rounds → 4 rounds. "Catch a Thief" 135% Attack → 140% Attack. "Stabbed the Nest" 65% Attack Power→ 68% Attack Power, 12TP→10TP. "Itali Cannon" 40tp→45tp. Reworked the skills of the new character, King of Hurry.
A new item has been added to the Item Shop in the town of Qiguo.
Repeatedly Horizontal Jump in the Marked Status: Chance of Receiving Attack *400→450
Changed the location when returning to the city.
Fixed a bug where the old save police didn't have the skill "Call for Reinforcements".

notes.title: The bug truth found the stick mother in the underworld forest!
notes.content:
The Mother of Sticks has been implemented: After clearing the Forest of the Netherworld once, the interaction of the Mother of Sticks will be added to the Chestnut Head Entertainment Club in the main city! The Mother of Sticks can attach a blessing to you that lasts for a journey.
Fixed an issue where the introduction of the character's passive skills in the old save was not changed, and Bruxman did not get the updated ability to add new skills
Adjusted the size of the icon for Level 3 equipment displayed on the map
The suona skill "Joy Away" has been modified to the light attribute and can only be used once per game, and the bug that the Joy Sent Away is played is the animation of the blue lobster skill.
Added pictures and music to the intro of some random events.
Fixed a bug where Purgatory Town didn't have monsters that couldn't be encountered.
Random ice has been added to the Sea Pheasant Islands! Event.
Fixed random ice out of the Corrupt Forest! Too many bugs.
The Deranged Kundemon now uses skills regularly instead of randomly.
Monkey Jiaojun "Jin ♂ Gang Rulai" lasts for 3 rounds → lasts for 4 rounds.
Corrected the text of Happy Chestnut Cat "Happy Time".
When the Sisyphus event is triggered during battle, a picture of Sisyphus will now be displayed
The Elbow God Set now requires a two-piece set to trigger
"Mamba Iron Elbow" has a cooldown of 2 turns → a cooldown of 1 turn

notes.title: Random ice has been added to all maps! event
notes.content:
Added random ice to all maps! Events (currently 11 in total).
Reduced leek boxes and ice! Supply: Refresh leek boxes and ice every time you go back to town! → refresh the leek box and ice daily!

Monkey Shhutchersen: ["I suddenly feel relieved" 20% HP penetration damage (light attribute) to boss damage→ 300% magic attack magic damage (light attribute) to boss damage.] ["Radiant" magic attack bonus 66%→ magic attack bonus 55% + 6% of your maximum HP magic damage.] Passive "Extreme Exposure" +5% Magic Reflection→ 10% chance to counterattack all enemies with Radiant Radiance when attacked. Radiant Radiant has a 10% →8% chance of causing Chaos]
Li Situ: Removed the passive "Traditional Mage" and added a new passive "Situ's Dead Words" to gain the Mark status when the HP value is below 1%. "Surrender with Elix" gains Marker status→ gain +1 Action Count status and cooldown for 2 turns. "Creatures are in a hurry to hang upside down" consumes MP7→6.

notes.content:
You can now go to the 3rd floor of Kuncheng.

🤓☝🏼 Because the minter did not find out before, Happy Chestnut Cat can use Super Happy Heal twice in a row when the number of actions is +1, resulting in Happy Chestnut Cat's milk volume being too explosive. So Happy Cat ushered in a simple and crude update: Happy Chestnut Cat in the Hapyy state cannot gain the +1 status of Actions.
